messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Multiplying matrices: var and double
parts:
We can't multiply Eigen matrices of double and var together. I found
this out while trying to get the Wishart distribution to compile for
vars.

I just checked in tests for Wishart. Some of them fail. I'll get them
to pass once we are able to multiply matrices together.

Regarding the multiplication, thoughts on how to make multiplication
work generally?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Multiplying matrices: var and double
parts:
You need to use stan::maths and stan::agrad matrix
functions. They're there exactly because they
auto-promote double matrices to var matrices. All
of the ops there are defined for all mixed types.

The bummer is that we lose all the template
expression goodness, like lazy evaluation of
intermediates. At least all the really expensive
matrix operations like solving are with single-typed
matrices.

I asked the Eigen developers and they say it's
going to require some work on their side with traits
to get two differently typed matrices to work together.
So far, it's only possible with regular and complex,
but the same logic would work for regular and auto-dif.

- Bob
